Port the whole mdrop_obj lifecycle composition and wire its relobj death and pet callers with the canonical object-generation environment.

source.branch: The killed tame stone giant releases its inventory through mon.c:m_detach -> steal.c:relobj -> mdrop_obj. For a carried boulder, mdrop_obj places the object before stacking it; mkobj.c:place_object calls vision.c:block_point when this is the square's first boulder.
callers: steal.c:relobj at 889 drops each monster inventory object through mdrop_obj during mon.c:m_detach after xkilled/mondead
steal.c:relobj also supplies the existing pet and monster inventory-release paths; verify those callers while keeping their broader behavior outside the source claim
dependencies: mkobj.c:place_object is an existing owner whose boulder branch consumes the blockPoint hook; reuse objectGenerationEnv rather than inventing a display update
Existing extract_from_minvent, flooreffects, stackobj, newsym, cansee, obj_no_longer_held, dealloc_obj and naming owners remain in source order; port no unrelated relobj behavior

evidence: Current evaluation challenges/evaluations/20261006180802-v22.json at 5913841d2eeb8e82110208f1966bb47f08725368 records 93/101 matching screens, 2651/2741 RNG calls and a stop before zero-based step 93: blockPoint is not available for otyp 475. Otyp 475 is BOULDER.

A bounded C/JavaScript trace on published B116 saved at the worker as .cache/A112-v22-readonly-trace.log reaches wand command -> weffects -> buzz/dobuzz -> xkilled -> mondead -> m_detach -> relobj -> mdrop_obj -> place_object. The trace made no behavior edits.

Read steal.c:mdrop_obj 814-846 and its relobj caller. C calls place_object for the dropped boulder before stackobj and completes the death drop; JavaScript js/steal.js passes plain dropEnv to place_object while supplying objectGenerationEnv(env) only to the following stackobj call.

The canonical objectGenerationHooks owner supplies blockPoint. The failing value is the first boulder on its square, so mkobj.c:place_object 2331-2334 requires that hook to update vision; the missing environment is the first differing operation.
The immutable C recording next logs rn2(6)=5 in xkilled at mon.c:3587. JavaScript never reaches that draw, confirming that the boulder drop blocks before the later treasure and revival tail.

Smallest independently assignable scope is whole steal.c:mdrop_obj 814-846 with its relobj death and pet callers. Verify the existing mkobj.c:place_object/vision contract and preserve extraction, floor effects, stacking, held-state cleanup, visibility and redraw order.
